summary.zh: 把互不依赖的任务拆开并行执行
summary.en: Split independent tasks across agents that run in parallel.

description.zh: 当有两项以上互不依赖、不共享状态的任务时，拆成并行子任务同时推进，再汇总结果。适合大范围检索、多文件改造这类可以切分的工作。需要运行环境支持子代理分发。
description.en: When two or more tasks have no shared state or ordering between them, splits the work into parallel subtasks and collects the results. Suits broad searches and multi-file changes. Requires a runtime that can dispatch subagents.
